waves.name: research
waves.prompt: Create research.py: a standalone stdlib-only module that documents the design of a tiny URL-shortener service. Include a DOCSTRING summary, a SERVICE_DESIGN dict (keys: endpoint, storage, slug_length, with one-line string values), and a function tradeoffs() that returns a list of (option, pro, con) tuples covering at least 3 storage options. No imports from sibling files.
waves.done_when: research.py imports cleanly and exposes SERVICE_DESIGN and tradeoffs()

waves.name: frontend
waves.prompt: Create frontend.py: a standalone stdlib-only module of CLI formatting helpers for a tiny URL-shortener service. Implement render_table(rows: list[tuple]) returning an aligned plain-text table, and shorten_output(url: str, slug: str) returning a one-line result string. No imports from sibling files.
waves.done_when: frontend.py imports cleanly and render_table formats a 2-row table with aligned columns

waves.name: qa
waves.prompt: Create qa.py: a standalone stdlib-only test-support module for a tiny URL-shortener service. Implement check_slug(slug: str) -> tuple[bool, str] validating slug charset and length (3-16 chars, [a-z0-9]), and run_checks(cases: list[tuple]) that runs check_slug over the cases and returns pass/fail counts as a dict. No imports from sibling files.
waves.done_when: qa.py imports cleanly; check_slug accepts 'abc123' and rejects 'XY!' and 'ab'
waves.review_cmd: python3 -c 'import qa; assert qa.check_slug("abc123")[0]; assert not qa.check_slug("ab")[0]'

waves.name: security
waves.prompt: Create security.py: a standalone stdlib-only input-safety module for a tiny URL-shortener service. Implement sanitize_url(url: str) that rejects non-http(s) schemes and strips control characters, raising ValueError on invalid input, and audit(candidates: list[str]) returning a list of booleans for which URLs are safe. No imports from sibling files.
waves.done_when: security.py imports cleanly; sanitize_url accepts 'https://x.dev' and raises ValueError on 'javascript:alert(1)'
waves.review_cmd:
python3 -c 'import security; security.sanitize_url("https://x.dev"); import sys
try: security.sanitize_url("javascript:alert(1)")
except ValueError: pass
else: sys.exit(1)'
